description: This file contains C functions for handling serialization and deserialization of various complex data structures, especially OVS_MAP and OVS_SMAP types, with support for multiple data types such as integers, booleans, doubles, strings, and UUIDs. It provides generic handlers for converting between JSON and internal representation, including from_json and to_json functions for different map types. The code also includes relevant includes and copyright/license information.
